title: Indian-flagged vessel sinks after projectile attack off Yemen coast
summary: An Indian-flagged mechanized sailing vessel sank off the coast of Yemen on Tuesday after being hit by a projectile. The vessel, MSV Faize Noore Oliya, was carrying 13 Indian crew members. All crew members were rescued. Union Minister for Ports, Shipping and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal attributed the incident to a projectile attack near Yemeni waters.
summary_points: An Indian-flagged mechanized sailing vessel sank off the coast of Yemen on Tuesday.

center: The opposition alleged that the incident highlighted the growing risks facing commercial shipping in West Asian waters despite stepped-up safety measures by the Indian government.
Repeatedly emphasized the need for increased security measures for Indian seafarers.
Cited the incident as an example of the need for greater international cooperation to address maritime security concerns.
